messages:
Zoe - Marketing: short thread — we need final hero lines for Hosted / Dedicated / Private + one webinar CTA wire by EOD.
Ben - Growth: agreed. single CTA = 'See it in action'. route larger orgs to AE.
Anya - Product: Dedicated hero should say predictable throughput + SLA hint. idea: 'Dedicated capacity 12 guaranteed throughput'.
Theo - Design: Private page visual = locked rack or on-prem map, avoid cloud art. keep single stat chip.
Mira - Content: quick hero candidates (<=45 chars): Hosted: 'Hosted API 12 go live in minutes.' Dedicated: 'Dedicated GPUs 12 steady production.' Private: 'Private deploys 12 run inside your network.'
Zoe - Marketing: include one-line subhead under hero about cost/latency controls (batching/caching/routing).
Ben - Growth: form fields to capture: company_size, infra_requirements, est_ARR, model_size. routing: if company_size>250 OR infra_requirements contains 'VPC' OR est_ARR>=60000 -> AE else SDR-nurture.
LeadFormBot: New form created: https://forms.example.com/redwood-launch-4680. Fields: company_name, company_size, infra_requirements, est_ARR, model_size.
Theo - Design: hero benchmark chips: Hosted: 'p95 token latency ~90ms' Dedicated: 'sustained throughput 180 tok/s per GPU' Private: 'Custom SLOs & network isolation'.
Mira - Content: CTA set: primary 'See it in action' on all pages; secondary 'Start trial' on Hosted/Dedicated; Private shows 'Contact sales'.
Zoe - Marketing: timeline: copy freeze Thu 11:00, designs Thu EOD, dev deploy Fri. post final snippets here and I'll assemble CMS import. :rocket:
